title: Temir qafas: afsonami yoki haqiqat?
caption:
Temur Boyazidni temir qafasga solganmi? 🤔 Afsona va haqiqat. Siz qaysi birini eshitgansiz? 👇

#amirtemur #boyazid #tarix #afsona #ozbekiston #tarixiyfaktlar #reels

scenes.text: Aytishlaricha, Amir Temur asir Boyazidni temir qafasga solib olib yurgan.
scenes.image: medieval iron cage on a wooden cart in fog, dramatic dark mood

scenes.text: Bu hikoya keyinchalik Yevropada juda mashhur bo'ldi va hatto teatr sahnalariga ham chiqdi.
scenes.image: Renaissance era theater stage with actors in oriental costumes, 16th century England, candle lights

scenes.text: Lekin Temur saroyi tarixchisi Sharafuddin Ali Yazdiy boshqacha yozadi.
scenes.image: medieval Persian historian writing a manuscript by oil lamp, books and scrolls around

scenes.text: Unga ko'ra, Temur asir sultonni hurmat bilan qabul qilgan va unga izzat ko'rsatgan.
scenes.image: Central Asian emperor respectfully greeting an Ottoman sultan inside a luxurious tent, carpets and lanterns

scenes.text: Ba'zi tarixchilar qafas aslida panjarali tahtiravon bo'lgan, deb hisoblaydi.
scenes.image: ornate wooden latticed palanquin carried between two horses on a desert road, medieval
single candle burning out in a dark stone room, melancholic atmosphere

scenes.text: Siz qaysi biriga ishonasiz? Izohda yozing va obuna bo'ling!
scenes.image: medieval turquoise-domed mausoleum in Samarkand at golden hour
